Camera and environments · evidence snapshot

Interpretation

The paired 2D screen covers 8 fixtures and 24 images; 24 treatment records report equal masks and annotations. Linear compositing visibly changes translucent occluder color; shade darkens the scene. Effects are qualitative and opt-in. Generic RGBA is a substitute in the pad family.

Early 3D views are an older prototype snapshot. Current camera and environment results remain unqualified. No real-image reference or model evaluation supports a realism or detector-performance claim. Sharp geometry masks may differ from blurred RGB boundaries.

Limits and next evidence

The 2D screen uses one background seed. Inspect native masks and edges and test additional backgrounds, scales and translucent references. Obtain completed current-revision scenes before evaluating geometry, motion or distortion; vary viewpoints and inspect mask overlays, clipping and rejection. No performance or default-promotion conclusion follows from these partial runs.
